{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Find internal test orders: revenue == 999999.99
test_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders found: {len(test_orders)}")
print("Sample of test orders:", test_orders[['order_id', 'revenue_clean']].head())

# Exclude them
effective_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = effective_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
